tagline: 佳能胶片相机，1979 年发布
description: 佳能于1979年推出的胶片相机。配备38mm, f/2.8 (4 elements in 3 groups)。快门速度Electronically-controlled programmed shutter and aperture. EV 6 (f/2.8 at 1/8 sec.) - 17 (f/16 at 1/500 sec.)。感光度25-400 ISO。

specs.快门: Electronically-controlled programmed shutter and aperture. EV 6 (f/2.8 at 1/8 sec.) - 17 (f/16 at 1/500 sec.)
specs.取景器: Reversed Galilean viewfinder with frame lines.
specs.英文简介: The Sure Shot (US)/AF35M (Europe)/Autoboy (Japan) was an early example (1979) of an active autofocus camera.
